info.title: API-DocTest-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Expiration API allows users to access information regarding the expiration dates of their loyalty points. This endpoint is essential for customers who want to manage their rewards effectively and ensure that they utilize their points before they expire. The API provides details on point expiration for specific hotel loyalty programs, making it a valuable resource for frequent travelers and loyalty program members. Businesses can integrate this functionality to enhance customer experience and retention by prompting users about their loyalty status.

get.description: Fetch information regarding the expiration of points in the system. This endpoint can be used to inform users about their points that are nearing expiration and help manage their rewards effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for the expiration of points. It must contain the necessary data in JSON format to process the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the expiration details of points.

ListHotelLoyaltyPointsExpiresRequest.description: Request body expected for the GET operation related to '_s_points_s_expire'. This should contain information in string format.
